rules: Ensure all Arabic text uses appropriate line heights (minimum 1.5 multiplier).
Headlines should be bold and authoritative, reflecting the official nature of the government company.
Never use center alignment for body text. Right-align all text for Arabic (RTL).
Use Primary (Deep Navy) for headers, primary CTAs, and active states. It signals stability and authority.
Use Background (Off-white) for the app screen backdrop and Surface (White) for cards.
Accent (Gold) is strictly for maintenance highlights, alerts, or key action buttons.
Ensure high contrast ratios (>4.5:1) for text on colored backgrounds.

layouts.grid: Mobile-first vertical stack (flex-col). Use 16px to 24px padding for screen containers.
rules: RTL Critical: Use `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `marginStart`, and `marginEnd` instead of left/right in React Native StyleSheet.
Touch targets must be at least 44x44px for accessibility on mobile devices.
Cards should have internal padding of 16px to 24px.
Utilize SafeAreaView for all main screen containers.

components.text_input: Native TextInput wrapped in a View. Must have `textAlign: 'right'` and right-aligned labels.
components.dropdown: Use standard React Native Picker (@react-native-picker/picker) or a custom Modal with a FlatList for the department selection.
components.buttons: Full-width on mobile. Height 48px minimum. Rounded corners (borderRadius: 8). Text centered and bold.
components.cards: White background, borderRadius: 12, subtle border (1px solid #E2E8F0) or slight shadow (elevation: 2 on Android).
components.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `testID` attribute (React Native equivalent of data-testid).

visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient shadows. Avoid heavy drop shadows. Rely on borders for structure if shadows are poorly supported.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0 around form inputs and cards.

motion.transitions: React Native LayoutAnimation for expanding/collapsing lists or accordions.
motion.interactions: Use TouchableOpacity (activeOpacity: 0.7) or Pressable with Android Ripple for immediate visual feedback on buttons.

accessibility.rtl: Application must explicitly enforce RTL mode: `I18nManager.forceRTL(true)`. Directional icons (like back arrows) must be flipped.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on Deep Navy has > 4.5:1 contrast.
accessibility.screen_readers: Add accessibilityLabel to all icon-only buttons.

image_urls.description: Aviation engine close-up. Used for Splash Screen or Login background with a heavy Deep Navy overlay to ensure text legibility.
Blue sky clouds. Can be used subtly in the top header section behind the company name.
Maintenance worker. Can be used in a blended, low-opacity state for 'No Activities Yet' empty states in the Employee view.

instructions_to_main_agent: TECH STACK: Expo React Native (NOT web-based React/Tailwind). Translate design guidelines into React Native StyleSheet or NativeWind styling. Use `.js` files instead of `.tsx`.
RTL CONFIG: Implement RTL properly. Set `I18nManager.allowRTL(true)` and `I18nManager.forceRTL(true)`. Align text to the right (`textAlign: 'right'`).
COMPANY BRANDING: Prominently feature 'الشركة العامة لخدمات الملاحة الجوية' in the Splash Screen, Login Header, and Dashboard Header.

DEPARTMENT DROPDOWN: The Maintenance form must include these exact dropdown departments: الموارد البشرية، المالي، التدقيق، التخطيط، مكتب المدير العام، الفني، الاتصالات، الحركة الجوية، السلامة، معلومات الطيران، التدريب، الجودة، تمكين المرأة، الإعلام.

ROLES & VIEWS: Implement two distinct flows. 1) Employee Flow: fill maintenance forms, view own history. 2) Admin Flow: default credentials `admin` / `12345`, manage users, view all activities, generate/export weekly report.
PDF REPORTING: For React Native, utilize `expo-print` and `expo-sharing` to generate and share the Admin's Weekly Report as a PDF document.
ICONS: Use `@expo/vector-icons` (e.g., FontAwesome5, Ionicons) for UI icons. Directional icons must mirror in RTL layout.
TESTING: Use `testID` property (not `data-testid`) on all inputs, buttons, and critical UI elements for end-to-end testing.
